warnings: Frozen 2026-09-17, before any evaluation was run. The held_out split is scored once, after all parameters are frozen.

Labels are human-read from magnified native-resolution crops; centre precision is roughly +/-15 px or 0.15x ball diameter, whichever is larger. Treat that as the noise floor on centre-error statistics.
The target is the ball being played. Other balls, tees, flagsticks and shoes in the scene are distractors; a prediction on one of them is a false positive.

pexels_6541964 carries no visible-ball labels: on the bare dirt lie no ball is locatable at source resolution. Its address frames are flagged ambiguous and it contributes only false-positive evidence.
pexels_37030686 and pexels_33511561 carry no not-visible labels: neither clip reaches a frame where the played ball has left, within the ranges inspected.
pexels_6541682 and pexels_6573611 are rights-cleared and deliberately unlabelled, held in reserve outside all three splits.
Media is local and gitignored. Reproduction needs the clips at the recorded SHA-256; the labels are bound to those bytes.
